newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's trade deficit seen at $19 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's trade deficit seen at $19 bln in 1996.

text.p: South Korea's customs-cleared trade deficit is forecast to expand to $19 billion this year against a $10.06 billion shortfall a year earlier, the trade ministry said on Wedensday.
The ministry earlier forecast a $11 billion to $12 billion deficit for the whole of 1996.

Lee Jae-gil, director general for the ministry's trade policy, said the deficit would widen to the level because of the plunge in semiconductor prices and the fall of steel and petrochemcial export prices.
Semiconductors are the biggest single item making up South Korean exports and their price has plummeted on the world markets, hurting the overall economy.
South Korea's trade deficit for the first nine months of this year totalled $14.96 billion from a $9.39 billion a year ago.
